expo.name: BlackNexa
expo.//owner: The EAS account that owns this project. Without it the CLI defaults to the logged-in personal account (mitdips) and every command fails the slug/projectId check.
expo.//splash: Legacy key, kept deliberately: it is the only splash Expo Go reads, since Expo Go ignores config plugins. The native splash for dev/production builds comes from the `expo-splash-screen` plugin below, which is what actually registers the screen the module can hide. Keep both in step.

infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: BlackNexa records audio you attach to a report. Recordings are stored as files with the report and are never transcribed.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: BlackNexa uses the camera so you can photograph or film evidence for a report.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: BlackNexa attaches photos and video from your library to a report as evidence.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: BlackNexa records where an incident happened, at the precision you choose, and surfaces local news and nearby help.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: BlackNexa records where an incident happened, at the precision you choose, and surfaces local news and nearby help.
infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: BlackNexa uses Face ID to unlock your session and your evidence vault.
